fields.name: mintAuthority
docs: Optional authority used to mint new tokens. The mint authority may only
be provided during mint creation. If no mint authority is present
then the mint has a fixed supply and no further tokens may be minted.

fields.name: decimals
docs: Number of base 10 digits to the right of the decimal place.

fields.name: isInitialized
docs: Is `true` if this structure has been initialized.

fields.name: freezeAuthority
docs: Optional authority to freeze token accounts.

display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.admin} creates the vault program's config ${accounts.config}, with a program fee on withdrawals of ${data.programFeeBps} paid to ${accounts.programFeeWallet}

${accounts.admin} creates vault ${accounts.vault} for ${accounts.stMint} with receipt token ${accounts.vrtMint}, depositing ${data.initializeTokenAmount} whose receipt tokens are locked in burn vault ${accounts.burnVault}
Does nothing: the program accepts this instruction and changes nothing
${accounts.admin} adds operator ${accounts.operator} to vault ${accounts.vault}, creating its delegation account ${accounts.vaultOperatorDelegation}
${accounts.admin} adds network ${accounts.ncn} to vault ${accounts.vault}, creating ticket ${accounts.vaultNcnTicket}
${accounts.payer} creates the record of how much slasher ${accounts.slasher} of network ${accounts.ncn} slashes operator ${accounts.operator} in vault ${accounts.vault} this epoch
${accounts.admin} adds slasher ${accounts.slasher} of network ${accounts.ncn} to vault ${accounts.vault}
${accounts.admin} opts vault ${accounts.vault} in to network ${accounts.ncn}; it becomes active after one full epoch of warm-up
${accounts.admin} opts vault ${accounts.vault} out of network ${accounts.ncn}; it ends after one full epoch of cooldown
${accounts.admin} lets slasher ${accounts.slasher} of network ${accounts.ncn} slash vault ${accounts.vault}; it becomes active after one full epoch of warm-up
${accounts.admin} stops slasher ${accounts.slasher} of network ${accounts.ncn} from slashing vault ${accounts.vault}; it ends after one full epoch of cooldown

${accounts.depositor} deposits ${data.amountIn} of vault ${accounts.vault}'s supported token for at least ${data.minAmountOut} of ${accounts.vrtMint} into ${accounts.depositorVrtTokenAccount}; the vault's deposit fee is minted to ${accounts.vaultFeeTokenAccount}

${accounts.staker} asks to withdraw from vault ${accounts.vault}, locking ${data.amount} of its receipt token from ${accounts.stakerVrtTokenAccount} in withdrawal ticket ${accounts.vaultStakerWithdrawalTicket}, to be paid out later, after one full epoch has passed
${accounts.oldOwner} gives withdrawal ticket ${accounts.vaultStakerWithdrawalTicket} of vault ${accounts.vault} to ${accounts.newOwner}

Pays out withdrawal ticket ${accounts.vaultStakerWithdrawalTicket} of vault ${accounts.vault}: its receipt tokens are burned and the vault's supported token goes to ${accounts.stakerTokenAccount} of ${accounts.staker}, less the vault's and the program's withdrawal fees
${accounts.admin} sets the most vault ${accounts.vault} accepts in deposits to ${data.amount} of its supported token

display.label: Withdrawal Fee from Next Epoch (none: unchanged)

display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.admin} changes the fees of vault ${accounts.vault}
${accounts.admin} sets the program fee on withdrawals from vaults to ${data.newFeeBps}
${accounts.programFeeAdmin} sets the wallet that receives the program fee to ${accounts.newFeeWallet}
${accounts.admin} sets vault ${accounts.vault} paused: ${data.isPaused}
${accounts.delegateAssetAdmin} lets ${accounts.delegate} move any amount of ${accounts.tokenMint} from vault ${accounts.vault}'s token account ${accounts.tokenAccount}
${accounts.oldAdmin} hands the admin role of vault ${accounts.vault}, and every other role it holds there, to ${accounts.newAdmin}
${accounts.admin} gives the ${data.vaultAdminRole} role of vault ${accounts.vault} to ${accounts.newAdmin}
${accounts.admin} delegates ${data.amount} of vault ${accounts.vault}'s supported token to operator ${accounts.operator}
${accounts.admin} starts cooling down ${data.amount} of vault ${accounts.vault}'s supported token delegated to operator ${accounts.operator}
Updates the balance vault ${accounts.vault} records to what ${accounts.vaultTokenAccount} holds, minting the reward fee, if any, in receipt tokens to ${accounts.vaultFeeTokenAccount}
${accounts.payer} starts this epoch's update of vault ${accounts.vault} in ${accounts.vaultUpdateStateTracker}
Updates operator ${accounts.operator}'s delegation in this epoch's update of vault ${accounts.vault}
${accounts.payer} closes the update of vault ${accounts.vault} for epoch ${data.ncnEpoch}, finishing the update if that is the current epoch, and takes back its rent
${accounts.admin} creates the metadata of ${accounts.vrtMint}: name ${data.name}, symbol ${data.symbol}
${accounts.admin} sets the metadata of ${accounts.vrtMint} to name ${data.name}, symbol ${data.symbol}
${accounts.oldAdmin} hands the admin role of the vault program's config to ${accounts.newAdmin}
